title: permission-mode configuration
description: Declarative permission modes for the pi coding agent. Global config has full authority; project config (.pi/permission-mode.json) is tighten-only.

$comment.description: Free-form note, ignored by the loader. /perm init writes the copy's provenance here.

acknowledgeDefaults.description: Extension version whose stock defaults you reviewed this file against. Silences 'outdated default' warnings until the shipped defaults change again. Global config only.

defaultMode.description: Name of the mode a new session starts in.

cycleOrder.description: Order modes are cycled with alt+m; also the display order.

modes.description: Map of mode name → mode definition.

plan.description: One-step plan approval (the Accept / Decline prompt after show_plan, the confirm on switching to the approve mode, /plan approve). Global config only.

approveMode.description: Mode to switch to when a plan is accepted. Default: build.

approveMessage.description: User message that starts the implementing turn; {path} is replaced by the plan path. Default: The plan in `{path}` is approved. Implement it now.

action.description: allow = pass through; ask = prompt; deny = block.

rule.description: A bare action, or an action plus an optional human-readable reason shown to the agent when the rule blocks (deny) or when an ask is refused. Global config only: a project config's reasons are ignored.

reason.description: Why this is blocked and what to do instead.

surfaceValue.description: An action, or a glob pattern→rule map (last match wins; '*' is the catch-all).

sandbox.description: OS sandbox profile for the mode.

askOnBlockedHost.description: Ask the user live when bash tries a host outside the allowlist (default true). false = silent deny. Projects may set false, never true.

allowRead.description: Paths readable again inside a denyRead region (deny-then-allow). Projects may only remove entries.

insideRoots.description: Roots the bash escape heuristic treats as inside (remote paths in ssh commands, say): a path under one does not prompt as outside the project, and the command runs sandboxed as usual. Bash only; grants no file-tool or sandbox access. Projects may remove entries, never add.

macos.description: macOS-only runtime options, off unless set and without effect elsewhere. Projects may set a key to false, never true.

allowLocalBinding.description: Direct loopback TCP plus binding local ports from sandboxed bash (database drivers, dev servers). Loopback services are not sandboxed; a 0.0.0.0 server is LAN-reachable.

enableWeakerNetworkIsolation.description: Let Go programs (gh, kubectl, terraform, gcloud) verify TLS by allowing the trustd lookup. trustd fetches revocation and issuer URLs outside the proxy, so this is an exfiltration channel.

linux.description: Linux-only runtime options, off unless set and without effect elsewhere. Projects may set a key to false, never true.

allowNestedUserNamespaces.description: Let a sandboxed command create user and mount namespaces of its own, which Chromium and Electron (Playwright, Puppeteer), rootless podman and buildah, and unshare -r need. Widens the kernel attack surface available to a sandboxed process.

path.description: Cross-cutting gate over ALL file access; a deny here overrides per-tool allows.

external_directory.description: Access to paths outside the project.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt to inject; '@plan' resolves to the dated Plan-mode prompt.

injectSandboxInfo.description: Inject the mode's sandbox boundaries (writable paths, denied reads, network allowlist) into the system prompt each turn (default true). Modes with sandbox.enabled:false never inject.

hideTools.description: Tools hidden from the model in this mode.

bypassProtectedPaths.description: Skip the .git/.env/dotfile write backstop (only trusted modes).
